content:
🎉 Excited to share that I've joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee!

After working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I'm honored to take on this role and help drive the standard forward. CDS Hooks has tremendous potential to improve clinical decision support by seamlessly integrating evidence-based guidance into clinician workflows at the point of care.

📢 If you're already using CDS Hooks in your implementation, please add it to our community registry: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability - it helps showcase the standard's real-world impact!

💡 Not using CDS Hooks yet? I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you implement the standard and bring smart, context-aware clinical decision support to your EHR workflows.

Looking forward to collaborating with the community to continue evolving this important standard!

#CDS #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthIT #Interoperability #FHIR #HealthcareInnovation
